Bid Summary.value: The Dallas Independent School District (Dallas ISD) is issuing this solicitation to procure student and staff computing devices, along with related deployment services. The scope includes tracking and delivering multiple shipments of various computer types to multiple locations, software installation, asset tagging and etching, device deployment and setup, and asset control reporting. Vendors must describe their ability to maintain inventory for temporary replacement devices and provide local facilities for storage and shipment in the Dallas/Fort Worth Metroplex. The contract term is three years, with two possible one-year extensions, not to exceed five years. Notably, there are requirements for teaming arrangements with certified M/WBE firms, which must play a meaningful and significant role in the project.
